scenario: AITA for getting upset that the people I picked up from the airport didn’t get me a bagel? | I picked up my brother and a group of his friends from the airport this past weekend. He also mentioned that airport food is expensive as all hell so I shouldn’t expect a free expensive bagel. AITA for being upset about this? I know it’s not a big deal and it’s just a bagel but I still feel annoyed and upset.
